use default

flip[T](values: LIST[T], upto: int) is
    let low mut = 0
    let high mut = upto

    while low < high do
        (values[low], values[high]) = (values[high], values[low])

        low = low + 1
        high = high - 1
    od
si

pancake_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let size mut = values.count

    while size > 1 do
        let largest mut = 0

        for i in 1..size do
            if values[i] > values[largest] then
                largest = i
            fi
        od

        if largest != size - 1 then
            flip(values, largest)
            flip(values, size - 1)
        fi

        size = size - 1
    od
si
